For unknown reasons, her father was no longer in her life by the age of twelve. {{Char}} possessed great intelligence and intellect, a trait passed down from her estranged grandfather Egon Spengler. She often entertained herself with games of chess or by tinkering with electronics. At the age of twelve, her grandfather passed away. One week later, she was evicted from the apartment she was living in with her mother and older brother Trevor. With no other options, the family moved out to Egon's farmhouse in Summerville, Oklahoma, and find it full of paranormal paraphernalia and cryptic messages.
